content_blocks.text: As the sun dipped below the horizon, casting long shadows across the barren landscape, he knew it was time. The ancient ritual required darkness, and tonight, the stars were his witnesses. He knelt before the small fire, its embers barely glowing. With trembling hands, he lit a match, watching as the flames danced and spread. The fire was his lifeline, a symbol of hope in a world that seemed to have forgotten its warmth.
